name: send-file
description: Deliver a produced file to the user: copies it into the notify outbox (outbox/files/), drops a desktop notification with the path, optionally xdg-opens it. Works headless — the outbox record persists.
use_when: handing a produced file to the user

args.name: send <path> [--name n] [--open] [--title t]
args.description: Copy file to outbox, notify, optionally open it.

args.name: list
args.description: List every delivered file with size/mtime.

stdout: JSON {delivered, notified, opened} or delivered-file list.
